targets.rationale: High responsibility density in UI orchestrator with well-isolated visual sub-panels, clear props contracts, and comprehensive browser QA test coverage.

planned_extractions.responsibility: Header, scenario selection, operational status badges, intent/plan version badges, and real-time execution metrics.
Operational human intervention controls: Pause, Resume, Cancel, Edit Goal, and command feedback alerts.
Fase 37 Dynamic Intent preview modal: natural language input, preset prompts, impact analysis badge, conflict alerts, and Sentinel blocks.
Mission cancellation safety dialog with mandatory operator justification input.
Overview tab: stage lifecycle progress, understanding summary, swarm agent allocations, execution timeline, and command audit ledger.
Plan tab: DAG task graph visualization, Kahn topological ordering, human approval gate controls, task priority dropdown, and topological reordering buttons.
Requirements Diff tab: lifecycle diff view with ADDED, MODIFIED, SUPERSEDED, CANCELLED indicators.
Plan Diff tab: DAG structural diff view, Kahn validation status badge ('DAG: SAFE & VALID'), added tasks, and cancelled tasks.
Evidence Invalidation tab: Zero False Success tracker, superseded evidence artifacts, and revalidation required notices.
Why Panel tab: causal explainability chains, replanning trigger provenance, and delta lineage tracking.
Repairs tab: autonomous self-healing diagnostics, AST patch diff view, and syntax repair logs.
Evidence tab: durable cryptographic evidence artifacts, verification statuses, and ledger inspector.
Preview tab: live interactive web application demo (expense tracker) verifying frontend delivery.

backend_evaluations.architectural_reason: High coupling with SQLite ACID transaction boundary, concurrency locks (asyncio.Lock), Security Sentinel authorization gates, and Kahn DAG scheduler invariants. Extracting sub-modules without staged multi-phase verification introduces high risk of race conditions and deadlock regressions.
Core multi-agent lifecycle orchestrator with 21 inbound consumers. Direct decomposition without staged compatibility shims would disrupt worker allocation across active swarms.
Agent collaboration consensus gate with shared state and turn-taking protocol invariants.
